text: ① 15:00 国新办举行国务院政策例行吹风会，请工信部副部长柯吉欣和中国人民银行、国务院国资委、市场监管总局、中国证监会有关负责人介绍加强中小企业回款难问题治理有关工作情况； ② 17:15 欧洲央行执委施纳贝尔在德国联邦经济事务和能源部的研讨会上发表主旨演说； ③ 20:30 加拿大8月CPI； ④ 21:00 欧洲央行执委奇波洛内发表讲话； ⑤ 23:15 欧洲央行行长拉加德讲话； 微信小程序搜索“见闻历”，了解更多。
text_en: ① 15:00 The State Council Information Office holds a regular State Council policy briefing, inviting Vice Minister of Industry and Information Technology Ke Jixin and relevant officials from the People's Bank of China, the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council, the State Administration for Market Regulation, and the China Securities Regulatory Commission to brief on efforts to strengthen the governance of the difficulty small and medium-sized enterprises face in getting paid; ② 17:15 ECB Executive Board member Isabel Schnabel delivers a keynote speech at a seminar of Germany's Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy; ③ 20:30 Canada August CPI; ④ 21:00 ECB Executive Board member Piero Cipollone speaks; ⑤ 23:15 ECB President Christine Lagarde speaks; search "Jianwen Calendar" on WeChat Mini Program for more.
